Messages.Author: Gomi no Sensei
Messages.Body:
In article <94n0ls$47l6$1...@www.univie.ac.at>,
Ferenci Stefan <a950...@unet.univie.ac.at> wrote:

>1. can two of my vampires play a political backlash when a vote fails.
>making 4 blood loss?

Sure.

>2. can two of my ventrues play elder kindred network therefore make him loss
>2 blood per vote difference?

Yep.

>3. A malk OoT rushes my sasha vykos he makes agg damage and plays
>rötschreck i make agg damage and play rötschreck what happens?

The acting minion gets to play effects first, and Rotschreck resolves when
played. By the time the Malk's controller plays Rotschreck, it's already
too late for you to play your own. Of course, if the Malk player rushes Sasha
on your turn via Madness Network, you can't play Rotschreck at all, since
it's your turn.

gomi

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
In article <94n0ls$47l6$1...@www.univie.ac.at>,
"Ferenci Stefan" <a950...@unet.univie.ac.at> wrote:

> 1. can two of my vampires play a political backlash when a vote fails.
> making 4 blood loss?

If they're both ready and untapped, yes.
It would make a 4 pool loss.

> 2. can two of my ventrues play elder kindred network therefore make
> him loss 2 blood per vote difference?

If they are both ready and untapped, yes.
The acting vampire's controller will lose 2 pool if the vote
fails, plus an additional 2 pool for every vote difference if
it fails.

> 3. A malk OoT rushes my sasha vykos he makes agg damage and plays
> rötschreck i make agg damage and play rötschreck what happens?

You don't play Rötschreck - combat ends as soon as the
acting Methuselah (who gets first chance to play) plays
her copy.
